dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #Ho there, if it isn't {NICKNAME}, the great hero who subdued the Dragon of the East and saved my homeland! Well met, well met!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of how you dispelled the Seven-Star Array...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Huh... "And so, with the aid of a faithful servant"... Wait. No, that won't do.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #"With the aid of a faithful friend, {NICKNAME} breached the path leading to the mines!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Is this really okay? We didn't ask her permission to use her in the story...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Ah, fret not, fret not! Heroes do not act as ordinary people might, and are not bound by such banal rules! Nobody will mind!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of the darkness and the creatures from the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: My, oh my. This is great. This is perfect! Give me a moment, let me write it all down.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: "The dark fog pressed in like an avalanche, and the two apostles of the Abyss, now separated, disappeared without a trace, just as they had appeared..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of the azure crystal you found in the depths of the Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: "The skies and the waters alike flowed across the crystal's surface, and the purple and red splotches faded..."

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #"The ancient creature of the ruins reeled, having taken a blow from {NICKNAME}'s iron fist, and it was at this moment that the star of the show arrived!"

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: "...The mysterious ally that came to the Traveler's aid had vanished without a trace, but the giant construct serpent had already been shattered to pieces by the crystal..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of the fluorescent fungi in the caves...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Fascinating... Almost unthinkable, really... Let me think for a moment before I say anything.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: "And though it be a giant mushroom towering unto the sky, it was helpless before the encroaching dark..."

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #"Answering the call, {NICKNAME} came forth, purifying the land and staving the crisis off..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of the nine Black Serpent Knights...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: This... This is wonderful! "And so, the fated Traveler said: 'Forget coming at me one by one. I could take all nine of you on at once!'"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, that's a bit of an exaggeration...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: It's alright... Now, if you'll allow me, I might exercise some creative license with the former lives of those nine swordsmen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of your search for your kin...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: That is... fascinating indeed. An ancient, forgotten land, sacrifices that went unacknowledged, and an unjust punishment to fall into folly... What huge themes! What an expansive tale!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: And to think that such stories are things that you've encountered in your travels, and that are so very close to your own aims...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Thank you for sharing all these with me. I will record them down. That said, I don't believe that I shall compose a poem from them yet... I believe that these will only be small fragments of your saga.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: I will not tell your tale with the limited skill that I have... I ask only that you tell me of your journey once it is complete.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: My intuition tells me that when that day comes, my ears shall be blessed with the most heroic tale known to this world.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of the Fatui who met with a crisis...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Haha! That's such an interesting story! "'A bitter day this is, that we should be saved by our great foe!' Serzhant Anton exclaimed with a sigh..."

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: "Yet those who meet as friends today, tomorrow may meet as foes."

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Thank you for helping me finish this epic poem... Ah, yes. Please, take this copy of my manuscript as thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Phew... This epic manuscript carries both my emotions and ambitions. Please, take it. It is what little I can do to repay you.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #You've come, {NICKNAME}, challenger of the Fatui Harbinger, and deliverer of Liyue from its monstrous sea-foes!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #Ah, if it isn't the one who dispersed the great storm that lay over the land of thunder, {NICKNAME}! Come, come!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #Hail to you, {NICKNAME}, great adventurer who once strode up to Dragonspine's very summit!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Well met, Traveler, before whom even Fatui Harbingers had to admit defeat in distant lands!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: This might seem a little sudden, good hero, but could you spare a moment to tell me a story or two of yours for me to turn into songs for those who come after?

choices.text: Well, if you just need me to tell you stories...

response.speaker: Taliesin
response.text: I would be most grateful if you were to agree! Well then, fire away! I'm listening.

choices.text: I've got a ton of stories to tell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of your adventures in The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Alright then. Please, do go on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell of the people you've met and the things you've seen.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Yes, please do tell me everything. I am all ears.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: #May all go well with you. Thank you for your time, {NICKNAME} — and may your valor be known throughout the world!
